attributes.name: Druva - Consecutive Recovery Failures
attributes.description: Detects a resource experiencing three or more restore or recovery failures during the rule look-back window.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects a resource experiencing three or more restore or recovery failures during the rule look-back window.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(TO_STRING(message), TO_STRING(druva.event_type), ""))
| EVAL state = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(TO_STRING(event.outcome), TO_STRING(event.outcome), ""))
| EVAL resource = COALESCE(TO_STRING(druva.resource.name), TO_STRING(druva.resource.name), TO_STRING(druva.profile.name))
| EVAL event_time = @timestamp
| WHERE resource IS NOT NULL
    AND (event_text LIKE "*recover*" OR event_text LIKE "*restore*")
    AND (event_text LIKE "*fail*" OR state == "failure")
| STATS failure_count = COUNT(*), first_failure = MIN(event_time), last_failure = MAX(event_time),
        failure_reasons = VALUES(TO_STRING(message))
  BY resource
| WHERE failure_count >= 3
